correspondence_candidate.scope: Development-only cross-check: exact TVDB episode ID plus input/Cinemeta date, unique canonical title/date plus unique target title/date. Not production behavior.

limitations: Tested actual main/ANSEmbed entrypoints at E1 of seasons1/2/3 only; this does not certify every backend/host/episode.
TMDB external episode finds were sampled at S1E1/E75, S2E1/E26 and S3E1/E25; empty matches are not proof that every episode lacks a TMDB association.
The canonical candidate proves51 S2/S3 metadata correspondences; 11 S1 rows do not match through that candidate. Existing successful external-ID paths must keep precedence.
SourceMap controls bypass discovery/input mapping and use unscoped development discovery. They are not proof of installed partition dispatch or a complete production fix.
Season1 source-control media returned403 in cloud. Season2/3 source-control media and native main API samples were reachable; decoded episode content remains unchecked.
